Using map projections well is in every geospatial professionals toolbox. But it 
is easy to make mistakes when working with map projections, particularly when 
facing a special question or task. 

In his blog, [Dominic Royé][dominic] offers a [practical guide to map projection 
mistakes][blog], with examples and explanations of common pitfalls, and how to 
fix them. Dominic supplements the examples in his guide with R code, but the 
concepts are applicable to any geospatial tool you may work with. 

Besides frequent mistakes and practical tips, Dominic also explains the taxonomy 
of projections – equal-area (equivalent), conformal, compromise, azimuthal, and 
equidistant – and which projection family is suitable for which kinds of 
questions and tasks. Overall a nice guide and good refresher.

[dominic]: https://dominicroye.github.io/about/
[blog]: https://dominicroye.github.io/blog/map-projections/
